particulars.description: The chargor's leasehold interest (as tenant) in the lease of the land and buildings at birch park care home, serpentine road, cleckheaton, being the subjects registered at the land registry under title number YY100775, as well as several other leasehold interests. For further details of the leasehold interests, please see the debenture.
